name: Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Set on the vibrant My Khe Beach, Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel is just 10-minute drive from Danang International Airport. The hotel has an outdoor pool and fitness centre.

Each contemporary room is equipped with air conditioning while Sea Front Premier features large windows with great views toward ocean.

The restaurants and bars offers authentic dining experiences with the SkyLine Bistro and Lounge on the rooftop as one of the highlights. Oasis Spa features a wide variety of modern and traditional treatments to rejuvenate your mind and body.

Song Han Bridge is 2 km from Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel, while Indochina Riverside Mall is 2.2 km from the property. The nearest airport is Da Nang International Airport, 6 km from Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

name: Monarque Hotel Danang
description:
Situated just a 2-minute walk to My Khe Beach, Monarque Hotel Danang offers accommodation in Danang. Featuring free WiFi access in entire property, the hotel has a rooftop swimming pool, spa and fitness centre.
Each room is equipped with a flat-sceen TV, air conditioning and a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find slippers, free toiletries and a hairdryer.

Guests can approach the 24-hour front desk for currency exchange, tour arrangements and concierge services.

Han Market is 2.2 km from Monarque Hotel Danang, while Asia Park Danang is 3.6 km away. The nearest airport is Da Nang International Airport, 6 km away.

Buffet breakfast and à la carte dining options are available at the on-site restaurant, while refreshing drinks are offered at the bars.

Complimentary Afternoon tea will be served as buffet from 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM everydayCouples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

name: Chicland Boutique Danang Beach Hotel
description:
About this propertyPrime Beachfront Location: Chicland Boutique Danang Beach Hotel in Da Nang offers direct beachfront access and stunning sea views. My Khe Beach is just a 2-minute walk away, while Da Nang International Airport lies 6 km from the property.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with panoramic views, a fitness centre, spa facilities, sun terrace, and free bicycles. Additional amenities include a restaurant, bar, massage services, and free WiFi throughout the hotel.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature air-conditioning, private bathrooms, sea views, balconies, and modern amenities such as minibars and flat-screen TVs. Family rooms and interconnected rooms cater to all travellers.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves Vietnamese, Asian, and international cuisines with vegetarian, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Dining options include lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails in a traditional, modern, or romantic ambience.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
